messages:
Emma (CS): Heads up — Silverfin usage down ~68% this month vs last. Renewal in ~5w. New procurement lead + they've kicked off a competitor pilot. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/silverfin/health :eyes:
Luis (AE): ack. Do we know which flows dropped? embeds vs chat vs reranks?
Emma (CS): Mostly chat + embeddings. Embeds calls are 75% lower. Chat token usage down but still some active seats. No billing disputes.
Raj (SRE): can we get a quick SQL on daily active API keys and avg tokens/day? I can run in 10.
Olivia (PM): any feature gaps the competitor highlighted? I saw their evaluation notes last month referencing faster embedding throughput.
Nora (Solutions Eng): I had a 1:1 with their ML lead (left last week) — they flagged 2 things: latency spikes on long sequences and a missing fine-tune migration guide. Also they were testing a quantized setup with another vendor.
Emma (CS): Sales flagged price sensitivity too. Luis — can you confirm deal stage?
Luis (AE): Renewal currently RFP stage, procurement contact changed. I'll ping procurement for timeline. If we can offer a short dedicated trial or canary with improved latency, might stall the switch.
Raj (SRE): quick findings from logs: increased 504s for session length >4096 tokens around 2026-02-10. Snippet: ```trace: handler timeout at 120s, kvcache miss spike``` Might be batching policy interacting with their long prompts.
Nora (Solutions Eng): We can enable prefix caching and tune batching TTL for their workload. Will need a dev flag and quick config change on Dedicated. I can run a demo config by EOD.
Olivia (PM): If we propose config + a 4-week dedicated trial at a modest uplift, what's the legal/ops lift? Also need to capture concrete perf numbers to show improvement vs competitor.
Emma (CS): Proposed plan: 1) Luis to schedule procurement sync in 24h, 2) Nora + Raj to run trial config and a short perf report by Thu, 3) Offer a 4-week dedicated pilot discount proposal (Luis + Emma), 4) Prep QBR-style one-pager comparing latency/throughput.
Luis (AE): I'll book procurement sync for Thu 3pm PT. tagging @procurement? (will add calendar invite after confirmation).
Raj (SRE): I'll run the SQL now and drop numbers in this thread in ~15m.
Nora (Solutions Eng): I'll spin up the config in staging, capture p95/p99, and attach results. If we can show >30% p95 latency improvement for long sequences, we escalate offer.
Emma (CS): Great — also adding a short customer health survey to the outreach to capture sentiment and adoption blockers. LMK if you need templates.
Luis (AE): I'll coordinate the commercial terms draft with legal after we see perf numbers.
triage-bot: reminder set: renewal-check-in in 5w (5999999000 + 3024000s).
Emma (CS): Thanks team. Action owners: Luis (AE) procurement sync, Nora (SE) perf config, Raj (SRE) metrics, Olivia (PM) competitor notes, Emma (CS) outreach + one-pager. Ping here with updates. :thumbsup:
